cohort: Taiwanese women, including 30 with severe preeclampsia and 30 normotensive controls in a discovery cohort, and 58 with severe preeclampsia and 55 controls in a confirmation cohort
finding: Women with severe preeclampsia had a higher relative abundance of Prevotella bivia in their vaginal microbiota and higher plasma TNF-α levels.
cross-section timing: At the time of caesarean delivery
